params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: `ProcessImage` throws an unhandled `UnableToCheckFileExistence` when one HEAD to the bucket does not answer while it makes a platform copy. A slow bucket is treated as a crash instead of being asked again.

## What happened

Nightwatch issue #60 (production, 2026-10-10 10:38:34, one occurrence): `League\Flysystem\UnableToCheckFileExistence: Unable to check existence for: 23283/car_image_6.jpg` at `app/Jobs/ProcessImage.php:174`.

That line is the `fileExists($bron)` check in `dupliceer()`, which runs before a platform copy is made from the original. Flysystem throws this exception when the bucket does not answer a HEAD (timeout or connection error). It does not mean the file is missing. Since 4 October 2026 the bucket is known to be intermittently slow, and `App\Support\StorageUnavailable::retryOnce()` exists for exactly this case: the sweeper commands and `ProcessVehiclePhoto` already use it. `ProcessImage` does not, so:

- one slow HEAD ends the attempt with an unhandled exception that gets reported;
- the job has `$tries = 10` and no backoff, so the queue retries immediately, while the bucket is still slow;
- the other bucket checks in the same method (`getFilename()`, the thumbnail check, the check after the copy) have the same exposure.

For context, `stocklist_errors` showed 28 failed `ProcessImage` jobs on 2026-10-10 (count only, no reasons). Whether those come from the same cause cannot be seen from the aggregate.

## Expected

A HEAD that does not answer is asked again once after a pause. If the bucket still does not answer, the job is released for a later attempt with a delay. It does not throw, and it does not mark the source as missing. When the attempts run out, `failed()` notes the reason on the tile as it already does.

Source: Portal mail:11 (forwarded Nightwatch alert).
params.title: ProcessImage crashes on a slow bucket HEAD instead of retrying (Nightwatch #60)
